text: 10 OVERDOSAGE 10.1 Human Overdosage Experience There has been no experience with overdosage of HPC, Cord Blood in human clinical trials. Single doses of LifeSouth CORDCYTE up to 71 x 10 7 TNC/kg have been administered. HPC, Cord Blood prepared for infusion may contain dimethyl sulfoxide (DMSO). The maximum tolerated dose of DMSO has not been established, but it is customary not to exceed a DMSO dose of 1 gm/kg/day when given intravenously. Several cases of altered mental status and coma have been reported with higher doses of DMSO.
